grammar.title: 语法知识 过去完成时
lines: 7 过去完成时与现在完成时放在一起为对比结构，通常情况下 过去完成时 会 搭配 一般过去时 使用表示强调事件、动作发生的是先后顺序。 将多个简单句合并的方式
现在完成时 过去完成时
have + done ( 站在现在 的部分/全部完成影响到现在) had + done ( 站在过去 的部分/全部完成影响到过去的当时)
When he get there, she is not there.She has left . （他到达那里时，她不在那里。她已经离开了。）强调的是目前情况 When he got there, she was not there.She had left . （他到达那里时，她不在那里。她已经离开了。）着重描述过去的情况
常用连词 when，after，as soon as，until，by that time 等 常连用的副词如already，just，never，never…before 也常与过去完成时连用。
一般过去 (后) 过去完成时 (先)
I did n’t know that she was a famous actress until you had told me.
The boys loved the zoo. They had never seen wild animals before .
When he got there she had left .
原句 使用连词 一般过去+过去完成

He finished work. He went home. (After) After he finished work, he went home. He went home after he finished work. After he had finished work (先) , he went home. (后) He went home, after he had finished work.

He finished lunch. He asked for a glass of water. (When) When he finished lunch, he asked for a glass of water. He asked for a glass of water when he finished lunch. When he had finished lunch, he asked for a glass of water. he asked for a glass of water, when he had finished lunch.

The sun set. We returned to our hotel. (as soon as) As soon as the sun set , we returned to our hotel. We returned to our hotel as soon as the sun set . As soon as the sun had set ,we returned to our hotel. we returned to our hotel, as soon as the sun had set .

sentences.title: 单词句型 Ask 与 Ask For
lines: 7 ask v. 问，询问；请求，要求，邀请 Except for 句首、句中（except for 含有对整体中的某一个方面不满意，强调整体当中某一方面除外。剩下的整体都不错。） besides 除…之外（还） 如果认为整体之中做这件事情的人除了整体之外，还有这个人也做了（包括），是加号=besides；如果认为整体之中做这件事情的人除了整体之外，这个人没有做（排除），是减号=except；如果放在句首，统一用 apart from 代替 except/besides which of 那一个（当 询问 在多个中的人或事物中偏爱哪一个或选择哪一个时） both of 两者都（它用在名词前时，of 可省略，当用在代词前面时不可省略） either of sb. 两者中的任何一个(肯定)用于肯定语境，表示在两者中的任何一个。 neither of sb. (否定)任何一个都"不" either 与 neither 都是对两个人或物而言 （后接单数名词） 。either 指 one or the other （不是这个就是那个） ，either 和 neither 后跟 of 时则指两个事物中的每一个。
I asked (Mary) a question. 问问题
They asked Tony to sing a song. 他们请托尼唱首歌。
They asked her to spend the weekend with them. 他们邀请她和他们一起度周末。
ask for the answer. 问答案
I asked for a cup of coffee, but they gave me a cup of tea. 我要一杯咖啡，但他们给了我一杯茶。
You are always asking for help. 你总是在寻求帮助
The article is very good except for his handwriing.
Except for his height, he is very excellent.

Except 不用于句首 Everyone has helped in some way apart from / except for / except you. All the passengers are millionaire except us. （减号） Apart from / Except for you, everyone has helped in some way. I invited everyone except George. / Except for George I invited everyone.
Apart from 习惯上喜欢放句首 Except for / Apart from this, everything is in order.
Which of the two do you prefer?
There are three books on the table. Which of them is yours?
Both books/Both of the books are interesting.
I like both of these bags.
Both of us/them left early.
I don't like the book.
Either of them. 选择一个使用
My sister doesn't like it either (否定“也”) .
You can choose either of the two options.
Which bag shall I use?
Neither of us like s it. (不定代词)
It doesn’t matter which. 随便
Neither of them. Use a suitcase. 哪个 都不行 。用个手提箱吧。

expand.title: 扩展知识 过去完成时vs.现在完成时
lines: 7 过去完成时与现在完成的角度相同，但出发点不同，过去完成时站在过去往前看，现在完成时站在现在往前面。 过去完成时、一般过去时和过去将来时 不规则动词的变化 § 每日习语 Play it by ear. 随机应变
时间/语态 过去完成时 在过去某个时间或事件之前 现在完成时 在过去某个时间或事件之前或包括当前时间
动词形式 had + done have/has + done
关联词 before, after, by the time, already since, for, just, yet, so far
示例 When he got there, she was not there. She had left . He has already finished his homework.
It is 10:00.I have waited for 2 hours. 现在完成时
It was 10:00.I had waited for 2 hours. 过去完成时
时态 过去完成时 Past Perfect 过去某个时间或事件之前 一般过去时 Simple Past 过去的某个具体时间 过去将来时 Future in the Past 过去某个时间点认为将会发生的动作或事件
动词形式 had + done did would/should + do
强调动作完成时间 是 否
描述动作发生时的状态 描述过去某个时间或事件之前已经发生或完成的动作 描述过去发生的动作或存在的状态 描述过去的观点或计划等
示例 By the time I arrived , they had already left . I walked to the park yesterday . She said she would call me later.
过去完成时 (最先) 一般过去时 (然后) 过去将来时 (最后)
A few hours earlier, someone had told the police § The plane was late... that thieves would try to steal the diamonds.
...a large crowd of people had gathered under the Town Hall clock. § On Wednesday evening, we went to the Town Hall. It would strike twelve in twenty minutes' time.
原型 过去式 过去分词 现在分词
leave left left leaving
learn learned learned
learnt learnt
drive drove driven driving
speak spoke spoken
